provenance.alignment: Exact source-camera timestamp when logged; otherwise nearest camera host-monotonic timestamp to the model observation (within 100 ms). Camera frame indices are mapped through the frozen export cuts.
provenance.predictions: Direct DT prefetches and action requests with fresh DT estimates; reused prefetches excluded. Values converted to seconds using the logged dt_schedule.source_fps; original model steps retained as value_steps.
provenance.gap_rule: Do not connect across clip cuts, recorded goal revisions, or prediction gaps greater than 5 seconds.

playback_encoding.sampling: Every sixth original frame, with exact final source frame replacing the last regular sample.
